prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you mean UV tanning beds or spray (sunless) tans, and what part of Columbus are you in (zip code or neighborhood)? That will let me recommend salons near you.

Meanwhile, here’s how to pick the “best” salon and a few quick pointers:
- Decide spray vs. UV: spray/airbrush is far safer (no UV exposure). If you want a natural, even result choose experienced spray techs who do a consultation and recommend the right solution for your skin tone.
- Check reviews: Google, Yelp and Facebook give recent customer photos and comments. Look for consistently high ratings and recent reviews.
- Look for professionalism: trained/ certified techs, clear pricing, patch tests for spray tans, well-kept equipment and clean facilities.
- Ask about products and options: DHA percentage and formulations (clear vs bronzer), organic or vegan options, express vs 8–24 hour development, booth type and bed intensities.
- Safety: if you use UV beds, verify staff ask about medications/skin conditions and limit session times. Consider sunless options if you have fair skin or history of skin cancer.
- Try a consultation or single session first to test color and service.

If you tell me your neighborhood and whether you want spray or UV, I’ll list top-rated salons near you and include contact details and what to expect.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
